integrity: Proof supplies exhaustive finite domain via 15 signed spanning-tree edges and 32 edge tests; standalone exact standard-library script independently cross-generates candidate set, symmetry orbits, rational squared norms and Burnside count. No external audit or formal proof certificate claimed.
scientific_limitations: Finite real Lipschitz-free norm ball for the 4-cube graph alone; natural graph-automorphism-plus-sign orbits rather than full abstract combinatorial symmetry; ten Euclidean shells require the specified inherited coordinate metric. Aggregate 990 facets and the inradius/contact counts were already published. External novelty risk and independent audit remain open.
title: Sixteen facet orbits and ten Euclidean shells of the four-cube transportation ball
